data.and-so-it-begins#And So It Begins\u0026h:
And So It Begins… Welcome to my new corner of the internet!
Setting up this blog was a fun exercise in using modern static site generation tools. I opted for:
Hugo: Blazingly fast, written in Go, and incredibly flexible. Hextra Theme: A clean, minimal, and documentation-focused theme that works great for blogs too. Used as a Hugo Module for easy updates. GitHub Pages: Free and reliable hosting for static sites. GitHub Actions: Automated builds and deployments triggered by pushing content. The goal here is to keep things minimalist and functional. The focus should be on the content, not flashy distractions.
I plan to write about technology, engineering practices, and perhaps some personal projects. Stay tuned!
